name: Azimuthal Hit Detection
definition: Determines whether an azimuthal hit occurs for a given ray. An azimuthal hit is an intersection with the ray and an azimuthal section, where azimuthal sections live in the XZ plane.
summary: Azimuthal Hit Detection determines ray intersections with spherical voxel grids by projecting 3D geometry onto the XZ plane for efficient 2D testing.
